name: Animal Shite Pile
description: Animal Shite Pile is a resource pile created by Horse and Donkey. It despawns after 15 Minutes if not collected.

name: Berry Bush
description: Berry Bush is a resource bush within the world of Calligo.

name: Briar Spruce Tree
description: The Briar Spruce Tree is a type of tree found within the world of Calligo. It has 3 stages of growth with 2 hours of time between each stage, for a total growth time of 4 hours. The amount of logs dropped by the tree change depending on its growth stage, with seeds only being dropped in the mature stage.

name: Cabbage Plant
description: Cabbage Plant is a plant that grows on a Tilled Field . It requires Cabbage Seed to plant. Cabbage plants take a total of 1.5 hours to grow. If Fertilizer is applied on the field, the growth time is reduced by 33% thus taking roughly 1 hour to grow.

name: Cassiterite Chunk
description: Cassiterite Chunk is a resource found in the underworld. It can only be found after 4 days have passed in the age.

name: Coal Chunk
description: Coal Chunk is a resource found in the underworld. It can only be found after 3 days have passed in the age.

name: Dead Wood Tree
description: Dead Wood Trees are a type of tree resource found within the world of Calligo. They will spawn 3 Dire Raven which will patrol close to the tree to protect it.

name: Flax Plant
description: Flax Plant is a plant that grows on a Tilled Field . It requires Flax Seed to plant. Flax plants take a total of 2 hours to grow. If Fertilizer is applied on the field, the growth time is reduced by 33% thus taking roughly 1 hour, 20 minutes to grow.

name: Hemp Plant
description: Hemp Plant is a resource that will start to spawn in Calligo 2 days into the age. After which it can be cultivated on a Tilled Field . It requires Hemp Seed for planting and need warm air temperatures to be sown. Hemp plants take a total of 3 hours to grow. If Fertilizer is applied on the field, the growth time is reduced by 33% thus taking roughly 2 hours to grow.

name: Relic Site
description: A Relic Site is a religious victory condition structure that will spawn at random location along the current empire territory border every 1 Hour, 30 Minutes. After spawning the site will be available for mining with a pickaxe for 15 minutes before despawning. Successfully mining the site will reward you with number of Religious Relics which can be handed in at a town Bounty Board to provide both Silver and 14 religious influence per trophy. The first empire to reach 10,000 influence will earn the religious victory.
